declarations.description:
A scroll container with themed scrollbars and edge shadows, like the ScrollArea of Mantine, Chakra and PrimeVue and
the side panels of Slack and Linear. Scrolling stays native (wheel, touch, keys, momentum, scroll snapping), so it
keeps the platform's feel; the scrollbar is themed through CSS (`scrollbar-width`, `scrollbar-color`, and the
WebKit pseudo-elements), and its thumb can fade in only while the pointer is over the area.

A shadow shows on each edge with content hidden behind it, and disappears once that edge is reached, so a list at
its top has no shadow above it. Set the shadow colour to `transparent` to turn shadows off, or a fade size above 0 to
fade the content into the edges instead. `orientation` picks the axes that scroll.

The region has a tab stop and a name (`label`), because a region that scrolls must be reachable by keyboard.
`scroll-edge` fires when a scroll reaches an edge: the hook for loading more in a feed or a chat. `viewport` is the
element that scrolls, for code that needs the real scroller; `scrollToEdge()` jumps to an edge.
declarations.name: ScrollArea

cssProperties.description: The tallest the area grows before it scrolls.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area--max-height

cssProperties.description: The scrollbar's thickness where it can be set (WebKit).
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__scrollbar--size

cssProperties.description: The thumb while the pointer is over the area; with a transparent thumb, the bar fades in on hover.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__thumb__hover--color

cssProperties.description: Above 0, the content fades into each edge with more beyond it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-scroll-area__fade--size

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name of the scroll region.

members.name: beyond
members.default: { top: false, bottom: false, start: false, end: false }
members.description: Edges with content hidden behind them.

members.name: fading
members.description: Whether a fade size is set: the mask is only applied then.

members.name: reached
members.description: Edges reached at the last measure, so `scroll-edge` fires once per arrival.

members.name: measuredOnce
members.description: The first measure records where the area starts without announcing it.

members.name: scrollToEdge
members.description: Scrolls to an edge: `top`, `bottom`, or `start` / `end` on the inline axis (which follow the writing direction).

members.name: measure
members.description: Works out which edges have content behind them, and fires `scroll-edge` for an edge just reached by a scroll.

events.name: scroll-edge
events.description: Fired when a scroll reaches an edge. Does not bubble, so a scroll area nested in another does not trigger the outer one's listener.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name of the scroll region.
